lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the pectoral fin, organized into at least five distinct vertical columns with 4-5 spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot clusters, creating a series of rectilinear anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extends horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibit irregular edge geometry suggestive of past tissue loss; a remora is visible attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clusters of reduced-diameter spots are visible on the cranial surface and the proximal leading edge of the pectoral fin.
